nodes.description: mapping(address => mapping(string => Datum)) private data in OpenOraclePriceData storing authenticated reporter data
mapping(bytes32 => uint) public prices in UniswapAnchoredView holding stored USD prices per symbolHash
immutable OpenOraclePriceData priceData oracle source of reporter prices
immutable address reporter trusted to sign price messages
immutable upper tolerance ratio between reporter price and uniswap anchor
immutable lower tolerance ratio between reporter price and uniswap anchor
immutable minimum time in seconds before the uniswap accumulator window is rotated
bool circuit breaker forcing the anchored view to use uniswap price directly
mapping(bytes32 => Observation) oldObservations holding the lagging TWAP window
mapping(bytes32 => Observation) newObservations holding the active TWAP window
immutable number of token configs actually supported by UniswapConfig
constant maxTokens = 30 upper bound on supported configs
OpenOracleData.source: recovers signer address from message and signature
OpenOraclePriceData.put external: decodes a signed message and stores the datum
putInternal: validates timestamp freshness against block.timestamp and writes storage
decodeMessage: recovers source and abi-decodes the oracle payload, checking kind == 'prices'
OpenOraclePriceData.get: reads timestamp and value for a source/key
OpenOraclePriceData.getPrice: reads only the value for a source/key
UniswapConfig constructor: validates configs.length and populates all immutable fields
getTokenConfig(uint i): returns the i-th TokenConfig, reverting if out of range
getTokenConfigBySymbol: hashes a symbol and looks up its config
getTokenConfigBySymbolHash: linear search over symbolHash immutables
getTokenConfigByCToken: linear search then external underlying() fallback
getTokenConfigByUnderlying: linear search over underlying immutables
UniswapAnchoredView.price: external view returning USD price for a symbol
priceInternal: resolves reporter/fixed USD/fixed ETH price sources
getUnderlyingPrice: Compound PriceOracle entrypoint scaling price by 1e30/baseUnit
postPrices external: writes oracle messages and refreshes stored prices
postPriceInternal: compares reporter price to anchor and updates prices or circuit breaker
isWithinAnchor: checks reporter vs anchor ratio within tolerance bounds
currentCumulativePrice: selects the correct uniswap cumulative accumulator
fetchEthPrice: derives ETH/USD price from the ETH uniswap anchor
fetchAnchorPrice: computes uniswap TWAP anchor price with block.timestamp deltas
pokeWindowValues: rotates old/new observation windows if anchorPeriod elapsed
invalidateReporter external: reporter-signed 'rotate' message sets reporterInvalidated
mul: overflow-proof multiplication helper
UniswapAnchoredView constructor: sets bounds, seeds observation windows
block.timestamp used for freshness checks and TWAP windows
ecrecover over a keccak256 signed-message hash returning a possibly-zero address
external calls to IUniswapV2Pair getReserves/price0CumulativeLast/price1CumulativeLast on an arbitrary pair address
external call CErc20(cToken).underlying() on a caller-supplied cToken address
external call priceData.put(message, signature) into the oracle contract from postPrices
unchecked multiplication a*b followed by require(c / a == b) overflow guard
message parameter of source()
signature parameter of source()
hash local: keccak256 of the ethereum signed message prefix plus message hash
message calldata parameter of put()
signature calldata parameter of put()

key parameter of putInternal()
value parameter of putInternal()
Datum storage prior referencing data[source][key]

signatures calldata array of postPrices()
symbols calldata array of postPrices()

symbol parameter of postPriceInternal()
ethPrice parameter of postPriceInternal()

anchorPrice local computed via fetchAnchorPrice or ethPrice
reporterPrice parameter of isWithinAnchor()
anchorPrice parameter of isWithinAnchor()
anchorRatio local: mul(anchorPrice, 100e16) / reporterPrice
timeElapsed local: block.timestamp - oldTimestamp

nowCumulativePrice local returned by pokeWindowValues()
rawUniswapPriceMantissa decoded from the FixedPoint average

anchorPrice local adjusted for token base units
timeElapsed local: block.timestamp - newObservation.timestamp

a parameter of mul()

edges.reason: block.timestamp is used in putInternal freshness comparison (timestamp < block.timestamp + 60 minutes), making stored data timestamp dependent
fetchAnchorPrice derives timeElapsed from block.timestamp, so the anchor price depends on miner-controllable time
pokeWindowValues compares block.timestamp to the observation timestamps to decide window rotation
constructor seeds oldObservations timestamp and accumulator for REPORTER configs
constructor seeds newObservations timestamp and accumulator for REPORTER configs
constructor assigns upperBoundAnchorRatio from anchorToleranceMantissa_
constructor assigns lowerBoundAnchorRatio from anchorToleranceMantissa_
UniswapConfig constructor writes numTokens = configs.length
UniswapConfig constructor requires configs.length <= maxTokens
getTokenConfig requires i < numTokens before returning a config
put delegates payload decoding to decodeMessage(message, signature)
put forwards decoded values to putInternal for storage
decodeMessage calls source(message, signature) to recover the claimed signer
putInternal writes Datum(timestamp, value) into data[source][key]
postPriceInternal writes the accepted price into prices[symbolHash]
reporterInvalidated circuit breaker selects whether anchor or reporter price is stored, bypassing price validation
postPriceInternal branches on isWithinAnchor(reporterPrice, anchorPrice)
postPriceInternal calls fetchAnchorPrice for non-ETH symbols
priceInternal reads prices[config.symbolHash] for REPORTER and prices[ethHash] for FIXED_ETH
price resolves the TokenConfig through getTokenConfigBySymbol
price forwards the resolved config into priceInternal
getUnderlyingPrice resolves config through getTokenConfigByCToken
getUnderlyingPrice scales priceInternal(config) by 1e30/baseUnit
getTokenConfigBySymbol hashes the symbol and delegates to getTokenConfigBySymbolHash
getTokenConfigBySymbolHash calls getTokenConfig(index) when hash is found
getTokenConfigByCToken falls back to getTokenConfigByUnderlying when no cToken index matches
getTokenConfigByUnderlying calls getTokenConfig(index) when underlying index is found
postPrices loops over symbols calling postPriceInternal
postPrices calls fetchEthPrice before updating prices
fetchEthPrice calls fetchAnchorPrice("ETH", config, ethBaseUnit)
fetchAnchorPrice calls pokeWindowValues(config) to obtain accumulators
pokeWindowValues calls currentCumulativePrice(config) for the latest accumulator
fetchAnchorPrice obtains the raw uniswap cumulative price through currentCumulativePrice
invalidateReporter recovers the signer with source(message, signature) and compares to reporter
invalidateReporter sets reporterInvalidated = true, disabling reporter-based price validation globally
fetchAnchorPrice uses mul for conversionFactor and baseUnit scaling
priceInternal uses mul(usdPerEth, config.fixedPrice) / ethBaseUnit
getUnderlyingPrice uses mul(1e30, priceInternal(config)) / config.baseUnit
isWithinAnchor uses mul(anchorPrice, 100e16) / reporterPrice
isWithinAnchor compares anchorRatio against upperBoundAnchorRatio
isWithinAnchor compares anchorRatio against lowerBoundAnchorRatio
postPrices makes an external call priceData.put(messages[i], signatures[i]) before state updates in the second loop
currentCumulativePrice makes external calls to an arbitrary pair contract for reserves and cumulative prices
getTokenConfigByCToken calls underlying() on the caller-supplied cToken address
source returns the ecrecover result of the signed-message hash, possibly address(0)
message is hashed and used to build the signed-message digest in source
signature is abi.decoded into (r, s, v) in source
hash is passed as the digest argument to ecrecover
message calldata flows from put into decodeMessage
signature calldata flows from put into decodeMessage/source
source is used as the outer mapping key in data[source][key]
timestamp is compared with block.timestamp to decide whether storage is written
key selects the datum slot in data[source][key]
value is stored as Datum.value on accepted writes
prior datum is read from storage and compared against timestamp
messages array is iterated and forwarded to priceData.put
signatures array is forwarded to priceData.put
symbols array is looped and passed to postPriceInternal
ethPrice from fetchEthPrice is passed as anchor input to postPriceInternal
symbol is used to resolve config and to query the reporter price
ethPrice serves as the anchor price when symbolHash == ethHash
reporterPrice is stored into prices[symbolHash] when within anchor
anchorPrice is stored into prices[symbolHash] when the reporter is invalidated
reporterPrice is the denominator of the anchor ratio and guards against zero
anchorPrice is multiplied by 100e16 to form the anchor ratio
anchorRatio is bounded by the upper and lower anchor ratios
timeElapsed divides the cumulative price delta used to derive the TWAP
oldTimestamp is required to be strictly less than block.timestamp and determines the elapsed time
nowCumulativePrice participates in the TWAP delta computation
rawUniswapPriceMantissa is multiplied by conversionFactor through mul
unscaledPriceMantissa is divided/scaled by baseUnit to produce the final anchorPrice
timeElapsed from block.timestamp is compared to anchorPeriod to rotate observations
cumulativePrice is returned and stored into the new observation window
message is abi.decoded and hashed against rotateHash in invalidateReporter
signature recovery must yield the trusted reporter address for invalidation to succeed
a is the left operand of the guarded multiplication
b is the right operand of the guarded multiplication
c holds the unchecked product verified by require(c / a == b)
mul performs an unchecked multiplication a * b then validates the result, the core overflow-sensitive operation

hash is only used as the ecrecover digest input

signatures pairs 1:1 with messages in postPrices()

anchorPrice is an argument of the tolerance check
